summary: Windows + PowerShell readiness tracker for backend API, local SQLite persistence, frontend build, installer packaging, performance, logging, and observability.
active_objective: Keep the local Windows desktop app production-ready; automated Release verification is passing, with only manual desktop and release-signing environment checks still open.
assumptions: Primary local environment is Windows with PowerShell 7.
Backend API is the loopback-only in-process HTTP server under src\OnlyRag.Api.
Local persistence is SQLite under src\OnlyRag.Infrastructure\Storage.
Frontend is the Vite/React WebView app under src\OnlyRag.Web.
Canonical local readiness command is pwsh .\scripts\Invoke-Gate.ps1 -Configuration Release.
Required environment variables are currently none; optional variables are ONLYRAG_WEB_DEV_SERVER and ONLYRAG_LIBREOFFICE_PATH.
decisions: Keep API binding restricted to loopback with session-token protection for /api/* endpoints.
Keep local backend logs sanitized and bounded by file rotation.
Prefer small verified observability fixes over speculative instrumentation.
Do not introduce new dependencies, telemetry backends, metrics exporters, schema changes, or public API changes without explicit production requirements.
current_tasks: Manually launch dotnet run --project .\src\OnlyRag.App\OnlyRag.App.csproj --configuration Debug and verify WebView2, loopback API, Qdrant startup, document import, job progress, diagnostics, and logs.
Define production observability requirements before adding structured metrics, retention policy changes, external telemetry, or traffic-level performance targets.
Install Inno Setup 6 and Windows SDK signing tools before signed installer verification.
next_tasks: Review Diagnostics endpoint cost under realistic polling frequency and document library size.
Profile ingestion, embedding, and retrieval with representative local documents before changing batching, caching, or concurrency defaults.
Verify installer build with pwsh .\scripts\Build-Installer.ps1 -Configuration Release on a packaging-capable Windows machine.
Verify signed installer lifecycle with pwsh .\scripts\Test-InstallerRelease.ps1 -InstallerPath .\artifacts\installer\OnlyRag-Setup-0.1.0-win-x64.exe -RequireSigned -RunInstallLifecycle.
blockers: Traffic, polling frequency, log retention, and metrics backend requirements are not defined.
Installer packaging is blocked locally because ISCC.exe from Inno Setup 6 was not found on PATH.
Signed release verification is blocked because signtool.exe was not found on PATH and a trusted code-signing certificate is not configured.
Interactive desktop startup and installer lifecycle verification require manual Windows execution.
risks: Diagnostics currently gathers live system, OCR, Ollama, and Qdrant status; frequent UI polling could become expensive without measured polling targets.
Local file logging is intentionally simple and sanitized; it is not a substitute for centralized production telemetry if fleet observability is required.
Ingestion, OCR, embedding, and translation throughput depend on local hardware, Ollama model choice, Qdrant state, LibreOffice, Python OCR packages, and document mix.
Parallel dotnet test runs can contend for shared obj outputs; run project-level backend tests serially when verifying locally.
Generated build outputs under bin, obj, dist, artifacts, and package caches must remain ignored and out of source changes.
structure_notes: Backend API source is under src\OnlyRag.Api.
SQLite storage, migrations, repositories, and ingestion persistence are under src\OnlyRag.Infrastructure\Storage.
Frontend source is under src\OnlyRag.Web\src; production output is generated under src\OnlyRag.Web\dist.
Backend and storage tests are under tests\OnlyRag.Api.Tests and tests\OnlyRag.Infrastructure.Tests.
Installer and release evidence outputs are expected under artifacts.

runtime: External Ollama endpoint configured by the user
development: Windows SDK signtool.exe for signed releases
external_services: Ollama local or trusted LAN endpoint
GitHub Actions Windows runner for CI

last_completed_work: Aligned the Playwright smoke test with the document listbox option role and passed the full Release repository gate.
open_questions: What production polling interval is expected for diagnostics and status views?
Should production observability remain local-file-only, or integrate with a specific metrics/log collector?
What document sizes, model choices, and concurrent job counts define the immediate production performance target?
handoff_notes: Keep this tracker current-only. Do not store prompt history, transcripts, secrets, stale completed task lists, or report-style logs.
